findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and had an age at cessation of 38.2 years (13936 days).

One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, a company holding 75 to 100 percent of shares.
No charges are registered against the company.
The accounts have unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded, and were last made up to 31 December 2023.
The confirmation statement has unknown overdue status, with no next due date recorded, and was last made up to 5 March 2025.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
